agent-coding.description: Runs a task on the default coding agent model instead of the caller's own model. Use for all coding, review, bug fixing tasks.

agent-planning.description: Runs a task on the default planning agent model instead of the caller's own model. Use for all planning, architecture tasks.

agent-review.description: Runs a cold review on the default review model, a different model family from the coding agent. Use for every review-branch and review-plan run.
